content: In 2 Thessalonians, Paul says the Lord is faithful and will guard you from whom?
explanation: He will strengthen you. “But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.” (2 Thessalonians 3:3, BSB)

content: In 2 Thessalonians, what did Paul say about anyone unwilling to work?
explanation: Everyone should do their part. “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.” (2 Thessalonians 3:10, BSB)

content: In 2 Thessalonians, Paul tells the brothers not to grow weary in what?
explanation: Keep doing good. “But as for you, brothers, do not grow weary in well-doing.” (2 Thessalonians 3:13, BSB)

content: In 2 Thessalonians, what false claim alarmed the believers?
options: The Day of the Lord had come
explanation: Paul told them not to be shaken. “alleging that the Day of the Lord has already come.” (2 Thessalonians 2:2, BSB)

content: In 2 Thessalonians, how did Paul mark his letters as truly his?
options: A greeting in his own hand
explanation: It was his mark in every letter. “This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. This is my mark in every letter” (2 Thessalonians 3:17, BSB)

content: Who sent 2 Thessalonians together with Paul and Timothy?
explanation: The same three wrote 1 Thessalonians. “Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians” (2 Thessalonians 1:1, BSB)
